research_findings: The waitlist endpoint (`joinWaitlist` in `src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`) was vulnerable to heavy traffic and lacked rate limiting, as indicated by a TODO comment.
new_features_added: Added Upstash Redis-based rate limiting to the waitlist server action, limiting requests per IP to 5 per minute.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement rate limiting across other unauthenticated endpoints.
Review Upstash rate limiting analytics to tune the limits.
